messages:
olivia: Repro attached: Android SDK (Retrofit+OkHttp) triggers parallel token refreshes after quick network flaps when cert pinning is enabled. Happens on emulator API 33.
ben: thanks. any logs or minimal steps?
olivia: steps: enable pinning in sample app, start with no network, then toggle airplane mode off. logs show two refresh starts and multiple cloned POSTs within 150ms. snippet:
```
I/OkHttp: <-- 401 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth
D/Auth: refresh start (ctx=aa1)
D/Auth: refresh start (ctx=bb2)
I/OkHttp: --> POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/session (clone)
```
tara: sounds like the Authenticator doesn't serialize refreshes. are we using a synchronized reflective helper? that can break under R8/minify.
olivia: sample-app reproduces both debug and release; releasing with minify makes it worse.
ben: quick fix idea: single in-flight refresh gate using AtomicReference of Deferred, and ensure authenticator awaits it before retrying. also defensive: only retry a request once after refresh.
tara: agree. add a consumer ProGuard rule in SDK (-keep class com.redwood.sdk.auth.** { *; }) and a runtime fallback to non-reflective locker so minified builds don't regress.
olivia: opened WIP PR with locker + proguard rule + an emulator smoke test. tagging @ci-bot to run android-emulator-33-smoke.
ci-bot: Job queued: android-emulator-33-smoke #7123. ETA ~11m :gear:
ben: after merge, update CHANGELOG under java/kotlin sdk: "fix: prevent auth refresh stampede with pinning (android)" and consider backport to 0.13.x.
tara: also add a short devex note: "OkHttp + cert pinning: guard your authenticators" in samples.
olivia: thanks all, will follow up with PR link and test results.
